cards.name: hero
cards.question: Roblox Username Generator
cards.qualifier: Type a word you like, pick a style, and get 30 Roblox username ideas that follow Roblox's rules: 3 to 20 characters, letters and numbers, and at most one underscore. Tap any idea to copy it.

cards.name: how-the-roblox-username
cards.title: How the Roblox username generator works

groups.label: 1. Type a word
groups.text: Use something you like rather than something about you.

groups.label: 2. Pick a style
groups.text: Cool: confident names like NorthPixel or Astro_Pixel.

groups.label: 3. Copy and check
groups.text: Tap any of the 30 ideas to copy it, or press More ideas for a new batch.

groups.label: Aesthetic Roblox names
groups.text: Aesthetic names pair a soft word with something from nature, the sky or a color.

cards.name: best-practices
cards.title: Tips for picking a Roblox username

good.label: Do
items: Make it easy to read and type
Your display name can be friendlier
Check that it passes the rules

cards.name: key-point
cards.quote: Roblox is popular with kids, and a username is public.
